incidents.name: GDS token business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: GDS credits token holders a share sized from the liquidity pair's live balance on every transfer, so a flash-loaned position repeatedly harvested that share and drained the pair's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: GDS 0xC1Bb12560468fb255A8e8431BDF883CC4cB3d278 created 2022-12-04T06:21:05Z by 0x5b18b1d988479526267a1aa0d66765cc7c3cc3a8, unrelated to attack sender 0xcf2362b46669e04b16d0780cf9b6e61c82de36a7; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The attack ran over two transactions; lossUsd uses the ~$180k reported by DeFiHackLabs and PeckShield.
